verdict.rationale: Asaas documents broad API coverage of its core financial operations: charges via Pix, boleto and card, plus subscriptions, payment links, split, anticipation, subaccounts, invoices, webhooks, transfers and full payment lifecycle management. However, there is no explicit UI/API parity claim, and several UI-marketed features have no evidence of API exposure: credit score lookup, Serasa negativação, the ERP/inventory module and multi-channel dunning notifications. missing for 10: an explicit parity statement, API evidence for credit checks, Serasa, ERP/inventory and notification-channel configuration, and independent corroboration.
